notes: Issue #163 (P1, PerfScore 72) -- per-frame heap alloc at 15+ sites. Fix pattern: replace per-call `std.ArrayList(u8) = .empty` + `compat.arrayListWriter` with a stack-allocated fixed buffer (fixedBufferStream) or a preallocated reusable send buffer. 5 call sites in endpoint/handshake_integration.zig, endpoint/client.zig, endpoint/pto.zig, connection/methods_a.zig, connection/methods_b.zig. Also packet.encodeInitialProtected internally allocates another ArrayList (packet.zig:522). Six bench variants model each call-site shape.
